configuration.stock_input: RGB PIL; no PNG encoding option

offline_analysis_runtime.score_arithmetic: float64 inner product of retained float32 vectors

evidence.raw_storage: Original commands, logs, full NPZ and native index files retained outside Git under this run ID.

limitations: Single-run qualification, no warmup or backend performance ranking.
Stock uses native PIL and CUDA text; replacements include PNG adaptation and CPU text.
Ray Data declares a cold native graph per image RM call; Daft declares a stateful wrapper across graphs. This pilot has no independent model load/destruction counters.
No semantic relevance labels, recall estimate, VLM sem_filter/map or PostgreSQL qualification.
Prior identity controls and prior failure originals retain their original source/run identities.

model_identity.prior_identity_controls: Reused original identity receipt and current file SHA checks; controls not rerun in this pilot.

tail_quantiles.reason: Repeated fixed payloads across configurations are not independent tail samples.

task.search_index: fresh stock-combined-64 index, unchanged before/after each search
task.workflow: RGB PIL object column -> native sem_index -> FaissVS -> native sem_search

timing.application_e2e: source content check/decode through native index/search and output validation; model startup and evidence serialization separate
timing.complete_query: Full native sem_search including online embedding, native load/search and output validation.
timing.evidence_write: Separate original receipt for vector/JSON serialization; receipt serialization is outside its own measured span.
timing.index_load_s: load_sem_index registration only; actual native FAISS load remains in sem_search.
timing.index_s: Native sem_index including gallery image embedding and persistence.
timing.native_workflow: FaissVS setup, native index/register and four complete queries, index sidecar/hash work and settings restoration; excludes the prior gallery identity calculation.
timing.png_encode: Per-RM wall and process CPU nanoseconds; process CPU includes concurrent threads.
timing.process_wall: CLI internal setup through executor close and owned Ray shutdown; excludes prior interpreter/module imports and later full-vector/result evidence writes.
timing.source_decode: Manifest load, source-byte SHA verification and eager RGB PIL decode; query/frame construction and gallery identity calculation follow.
timing.startup: CLI setup, identity and thread-pool checks, stock/text RM initialization and executor construction; lazy image-model load may remain in an RM call.
timing.supervisor_wall: Owned child invocation through physical-exit confirmation, including recorded cleanup; no evidence or cleanup interval is subtracted.
